name: Adaptive Cards
short_description: Adaptive Cards are platform-agnostic UI snippets written in JSON that host apps such as Microsoft Teams, Outlook and Copilot Studio render as native UI; Power Automate uses them for interactive approval and notification messages.

evidence.quote: and at the source, approvals created with adaptive cards that confess when the user is gone
responding to adaptive cards from other apps
